title: hymenophyllum polyanthos var. blumeanum
intro: Hymenophyllum polyanthos var. blumeanum, commonly known as the Blume's resurrection fern, is a species of fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. This plant is known to have several health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory health due to its high antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of Blume's resurrection fern include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe wounds and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
